_comment: Iteration 175 §4 advisory baseline. The strict scan finds 15436 violations at the latest commit. Most are false positives (HTML element/attribute names, type literal strings detected as 'long English literals' by the conservative scanner). The CJK violation subset is ~1697 — these are the actual zh-CN literals that need extracting to i18n keys. The CI gate runs in advisory mode (warning only) until the count reaches 0. Set CHECK_I18N_STRICT_BLOCKING=true in the frontend-lint CI step to force-block. Once violations reach 0, this baseline file can be deleted.
